task.title: Thanksgiving-week holiday hours, Pacific stores
task.objective: Publish Thanksgiving-week holiday hours (closed Thursday, 6am-10pm Friday, normal hours otherwise) at the Pacific stores except Boise, and notify each store manager once. Obtain store manager approval before publishing any schedule that puts an employee into overtime.
task.outcome: Eight stores have holiday hours published and their managers notified once. Spokane's overtime approval is verified. Boise is handled as the user directs.

success_criteria.description: Holiday hours published at PDX, SEA, TAC, GEG, EUG, SLE, BND and OLM.
Each of the eight managers notified once.
AR-30918 verified approved before the Spokane schedule was published.
User has confirmed how Boise (BOI) is handled.

includes: Holiday hours at PDX, SEA, TAC, GEG, EUG, SLE, BND and OLM

completed.description: Listed the nine stores. All showed holiday hours as not published.
Requested overtime approval AR-30918 for E-4471 at Spokane. Status was pending at the last successful check.
Published holiday hours at eight stores: PDX, SEA, TAC, GEG, EUG, SLE, BND and OLM. The GEG publish ran before AR-30918 was approved.
Notified the managers of PDX, SEA and TAC.

focus.description: Recovering after the store-system connection dropped during the manager-notice step. Five notices and the AR-30918 check are outstanding, and the Spokane publish needs a decision.

next.description: Tell the user now: the Spokane holiday publish ran before AR-30918 was approved, against operator policy and their instruction. Correct the earlier summary, which said Spokane had not been published.
Check that the store system responds, then re-check AR-30918 with get_approval.
Ask the user whether to revert the Spokane publish and how to word the Spokane notice. Do not send the drafted text as written.
Send the holiday-hours notice once each to the EUG, SLE, BND and OLM managers, after confirming that none was delivered.
Hold Boise until the user confirms. Then ask whether it should receive holiday hours.

statements.text: Roll out Thanksgiving-week holiday hours (closed Thursday, 6am-10pm Friday, normal hours otherwise) to all nine Pacific stores.
For each store, publish its hours, then notify its manager, once each.
Request overtime approval for E-4471 at Spokane first. Do not publish the Spokane schedule until that approval is granted.
Leave Boise (BOI) alone until the user confirms. It is mid-renovation and may be closed all week.
A schedule that puts an employee into overtime may be published only after the store manager approves it. Use request_overtime_approval, then get_approval.
Holiday hours were published at PDX, SEA, TAC, GEG, EUG, SLE, BND and OLM. Each publish call returned success.

statements.text: The Spokane (GEG) publish ran before AR-30918 was decided, and no approval check came first. This breaks the operator policy and the user's instruction.

statements.text: Notices were delivered to PDX, SEA and TAC. Notices to GEG, EUG, SLE, BND and OLM failed with a lost-connection error that reported no action taken.

Resending the five failed notices will not duplicate any notice that was already delivered.
Is Boise closed all week, and should it receive holiday hours?
Should the Spokane holiday publish be reverted until AR-30918 is approved, or left in place?

preconditions.description: The store system answers a read, such as list_stores, before any write.
AR-30918 is verified approved before any further change to the Spokane schedule.

stop_conditions.description: Do not publish, notify, or change anything at Boise (BOI) until the user confirms.
Do not change the Spokane schedule or send the Spokane notice until the user answers the open Spokane question and AR-30918 is verified.
Do not publish any schedule that adds overtime unless its approval is verified in the store system.

recovery.description: Tell the user that the Spokane holiday publish ran before approval, and correct the earlier summary.
Confirm the store system responds, then check AR-30918 with get_approval.
After the user agrees on the Spokane wording, send the remaining notices once each, confirming first that none was delivered.

incompatibilities: Store system state may have changed since capture. The results recorded here are as of the last successful call.
